fields.heading: Are there enough doors, and does any code reach around one?

fields.heading: Is each door tested once, in its contract, and faked everywhere else?

fields.heading: Which tests are superfluous, duplicated or over-broad?

fields.heading: Which test files are slowest, and what makes them slow?

fields.heading: Does every file over 1,000 lines do one job on one abstraction level?
